item.title: Water main break leaves dozens without service in Northeast Philadelphia
item.description: The Philadelphia Water Department (PWD) is investigating a leak that left dozens of homes without water service Tuesday morning in Northeast Philadelphia.The leak was reported before 7 a.m. near Elmhurst and Robbins Streets, where crews identified a possible broken 8-inch cast iron main. item.title: Atlantic City Mayor Marty Small's daughter testifies in abuse trial
item.description: The trial of Atlantic City Mayor Marty Small continues with his daughter taking the stand. Mayor Small appeared stoic as he entered the Atlantic County Criminal Court Complex for the second day of his trial. The prosecution's first key witness was his 17-year-old daughter, who testified about alleged physical abuse by her father. Due to her age, no cameras or recordings were allowed in the courtroom. item.title: Teen boy and man shot and killed in Germantown: police
item.description: A shooting on West Queen Lane has left two people dead, prompting an ongoing investigation by Philadelphia police. Police arrived at the scene on the 500 block of West Queen Lane just after 5 p.m. They found a 30-year-old man and a 16-year-old boy with gunshot wounds.
